# Western constellation illustrations

Unmodified illustrations by **Johan Meuris**, distributed by the Stellarium Western sky-culture project under the **Free Art License**. The precise licence is available at [Free Art License 1.3](https://artlibre.org/licence/lal/en/); upstream's original wording is retained in [description](UPSTREAM-description.md). The upstream source and all 85 artwork files with SHA-256 are recorded in [overlay manifest](../../data/catalog/overlays-manifest.json), frozen commit `014fbb5e59233d133c22f9811af96b67d05a95c9`.

Artwork bytes were not edited. Yorungez extracts numeric three-star anchor metadata and projects the images as a spherical mesh; no Stellarium runtime/AGPL engine code is imported. HYG anchor positions retain their separate CC BY-SA 4.0 attribution. Upstream describes its text/data as CC BY-SA without a version in the Western notice; that wording is not relabelled here. Art and metadata are distinct from Yorungez's original code licence, Apache-2.0 (K-029).

When redistributing these assets retain author, source, licence link, original notice and file manifest. There is no artwork for `con-pup`, `con-ser`, or `con-vel` in the selected revision; no replacement is invented.
